During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] forces '''engaged one another''' near the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]]. Although the Jedi were the presumed victors, the pirates refused to surrender, as the new [[Enhanced Security and Enforcement Act]] mandated that captured brigands be sentenced to death. Ultimately, the enemy force was destroyed by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
